name: Summon Swarm
description: Valaara summons a swarm of centipedes that cover a 10-foot-radius sphere at a point of its choosing within 120 feet, afflicting all creatures in the area (except Valaara, who is immune). Each creature must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage, and is not poisoned.
